description: Sherdog MMA fighter profile by Sherdog fighter id: name, nationality, height, weight, win/loss record and the fight history (result, opponent, event, date, method, round). Public profile pages; no draws or upcoming bouts beyond what the page lists. Related tools on this server, for a different need: dev_ufcstats when you need UFC fighter career profile from the official UFC.com; dev_thesportsdb when you need TheSportsDB team search: up to 5 teams matching a name. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

fights.description: How many recent fights to return, 1 to 50 (default 10)

id.description: Sherdog fighter id, the number at the end of the fighter URL (e.g. 27)
